nodes.name: SDNN
nodes.text_evidence: SDNN, measured in the unit of milliseconds (ms), is the standard deviation of the normal beat intervals (denoted NN intervals)

nodes.name: Capture short-term high-frequency variation and long-term low-frequency components
nodes.text_evidence: encompasses both short-term high-frequency variation (mostly parasympathetically-mediated RSA) and long-term low-frequency components

nodes.name: longer periods (especially 24h)
nodes.text_evidence: accuracy of SDNN is higher for longer recording periods, especially over 24 h periods

nodes.name: SDANN
nodes.text_evidence: the standard deviation of average NN is extracted for each 5 min segment of the long-term HR time series (e.g., 24 h recordings) (SDANN)

nodes.name: Capture long-term components contributing to HRV

nodes.name: SDNNI (SDNN Index)
nodes.text_evidence: SDNN index (SDNNI) is the mean of the standard deviations of NN calculated per 5 min segment
